# Selma Lumiranta

[Notables](../Notables.md)

*Game data as of 26 May 309.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

Sub-Lieutenant, commanding officer of [Far Ledger](../Ships/Far-Ledger.md).

Born to [House Oskari](../Houses/Oskari.md), by surname.

Traits: Courteous, Determined, Friendly and Self-confident.

The Wayfinders' most prolific explorer. Commanding [Far Ledger](../Ships/Far-Ledger.md), she has charted one empty or dim system after another, and her tenth discovery, Penwarre, made her the first officer awarded the Wayfinder's Compass, Class II.

## Skills

Strong in survey and logistics. Capable in crew training, reaction, light tactical and political reliability.
